STEP 1 - Scene: A lunch tray with a fruit cup, two wrapped sandwiches (wraps), and a glass of orange juice. The overhead photo shows no other meal components.

STEP 2 - Vessel: The fruit is in a cereal-sized bowl (~15 cm, area ~177 cm²). The wraps sit on a side plate (~20 cm, area ~314 cm²). The juice is in a small glass (~250 ml).

STEP 3 - Items: Mixed fruit (watermelon, cantaloupe, grapes, blueberries); two wraps containing tortilla, sliced meat (ham or turkey), cheese, shredded lettuce, and carrot; orange juice.

STEP 4 - Area: Fruit covers ~70% of the bowl (~124 cm²). The wraps cover ~50% of the plate (~157 cm²).

STEP 5 - Volume: Fruit: 124 cm² × ~3 cm ≈ 370 ml. Wraps: 157 cm² × ~5 cm ≈ 785 ml gross envelope, but the rolls are dense. Juice: ~200 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Fruit: 370 ml × 0.6 ≈ 220 g. Wraps: the dense rolled items are taken directly at about 250 g total (tortilla 90 g, meat 60 g, cheese 40 g, vegetables 60 g). Juice: 200 ml × 1.0 = 200 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Fruit 220 g × 50 kcal/100 g ≈ 110 kcal. Tortilla 90 g × 300 ≈ 270 kcal. Meat 60 g × 110 ≈ 66 kcal. Cheese 40 g × 350 ≈ 140 kcal. Vegetables 60 g × 20 ≈ 12 kcal. Juice 200 g × 45 ≈ 90 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 670 g and ≈ 690 kcal. That is plausible for a fruit cup, two wraps, and a glass of juice.
